title: PCR and gel electrophoresis
body:
 Created PCR mix for 4 different DNA sequences and 5 controls:
 DNA Sequences:
 6-His imcherry (708bp)
 mcp-1 + HlyA(713bp)
 mcp-1 + PelB (536bp)
 mcp-1 expression
 Controls:
 DNA only
 FP only
 No DNA
 Primers only
 RP only
 No primers.
 The PCR (Total 25 µl) mix was created by adding the following ingredients in order:
1. NF H2O: 8.9 µl
2. Buffer: 5 µl
3. dNTP mix: 0.5 µl
4. Forward primer: 0.2 µl
5. Reverse primer: 0.2 µl
6. DNA sequence: 10 µl
 PCR was run by the following process:
Denaturalisation: 95oC/98oC – 2min
Annealing (30 times): 95oC - 20s; Tm(67oC) – 30s;
Extension: 72oC-20s/kb -> 10min
 Gel Electrophoresis (Gel preparation and electrophoresis)
1% Agarose Gel(1X); Heated in the oven for 30-45s, till transparency is achieved.
Loading Order:
1.Gene Ruler
2.imCherry
3.mcp-1 Hly-A
4.mcp-1 Hly-A
Blank 6.mcp expression
7. Control (no DNA)
8.Control (no primer)
Gene ruler: 1µl loading dye + 1µl gene ruler + 1µl NF H2O
2-8: 2µl loading dye + 10µl DNA (PCR mix)

title: RFP plasmid retransformation
body:
- Re-transforming RFP to get more stock of pSB1C3-RFP plasmid we got from 2019 iGEM, since we have to remove the backbone from it via PCR and are running low on our stock. Re-transforming instead of picking a colony again because the RFP plates have been out for ~a month so are probably bad by now. This was confirmed by re-picking and miniprepping, resulted in low yield.
- 5 transformations: 2 with 2019 RFP plasmid that was left out (118ng/ul) (Plates labelled 1 and 2, used 1ul and 2ul) 2 with 2019 RFP plasmid (17ng/ul) (Plates labelled 3 and 4, used 5ul and 12ul). 1 with 2017 RFP plasmid (10pg/ul) (Plate labelled 5, used 1 ul).
- Transformation #5 used fresh SOC instead of supernatant to resuspend
- Only 4 LB + CM plates are left, should make more asap!
selection_note: 记录5次转化、不同年份/浓度的RFP质粒、SOC与LB+CM平板，并报告重挑菌落/miniprep低产量；非纯计划。

title: Golden Gate assembly of psicA and RFP construct
body:
- Transforming RFP Constructs
- Moved 5 transformation plates from 37C room to 4C room (as per instructed by Janella)
- Golden Gate Assembly of psicA and golden gate compatible RFP construct (x2 duplicates)
1. IDT psicA gene fragment preparation
- Added 25 uL to make 10 ng/uL of psicA
- Incubated for ~10 minutes at 60 degrees celsius to ensure the solvent comes in contact with the tiny pellet.
2. Golden Gate Assembly Reaction:
- 0.5 uL of T4 ligase
- 1 uL BsaI
- 2 uL 10X T4 Buffer
- 2 uL 10X BSA Buffer
- 6 uL psicA insert + 0.5 uL of DNA amplicon
- Fix volume to 20 uL using H2O
3. Incubated Golden Gate Assembly reaction at 37 degrees celsius for 1hr
selection_note: 同日同实验跨页合并，含T4 ligase、BsaI、buffer、基因片段与37°C孵育1小时的已执行记录；按PDF阅读顺序，不按日期重排。

title: RFP transformation plate observations and retransformation
body:
- Checked plates from Madina, Taylor, and Janella’s transformation on July 5th. The two with 2019 RFP plasmid (17ng/ul, with volumes 5ul and 12ul) worked and had red colonies, but the plates had way too much growth. the 2017 10pg test kit worked, but had few colonies. 2 with 2019 RFP plasmid that was left out (118ng/ul) had growth but colonies were not red, indicating a problem with plasmid or plates.
- Retransformed 50ul of competent cells with the 2019 RFP plasmid (17ng/ul) using 2.5ul to get less growth on plates. Included a negative control without any DNA to sort out what is happening with non red growth, but couldn’t plate it because of no more CM plates left.
- Practiced a mock ligation without DNA.
- Placed transformation at 37 degrees in the warm room.
selection_note: 有红色菌落/生长观察、50ul感受态细胞和2.5ul质粒再转化；明确保留阴性对照未能涂板的事实，不补成已执行。

title: DNA extraction of collected samples
body:
Quick Protocol: DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit (for insects)
Materials Needed:
● DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit (Qiagen)
● 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes
● Ethanol (96–100%)
● Proteinase K
● Buffer ATL, AL, AW1, AW2, AE

1. Sample Prep
● 5 samples collected from farms were used (4 samples collected by Baha and 1 sample collected by Wahei)
● Samples were centrifuged to spin down the insects and ethanol was discarded
● Incubated in 56 °C until excess ethanol dried out
● Add 180 µL Buffer ATL.
● Add 20 µL Proteinase K.
● Vortex briefly or flick.
● Incubate at 56 °C for 1–3 hours (or overnight) until fully lysed.
2. Lysis
● Add 200 µL Buffer AL, mix.
● Add 200 µL ethanol (96–100%), mix well.
3. Binding
● Transfer the mixture to a DNeasy spin column in a collection tube.
● Centrifuge 1 min at ≥6000 x g (8000 rpm).
● Discard flow-through.
4. Wash
● Add 500 µL Buffer AW1, spin 1 min, discard flow-through.
● x
5. Elution
● Place column in a clean 1.5 mL tube.
● Add 100 µL Buffer AE (or nuclease-free water).
● Incubate 1 min, then centrifuge 1 min at ≥6000 x g.

Store:
● Store eluted DNA at –20 °C.
selection_note: 记录5个实采样本已使用、离心与干燥，并附DNeasy kit材料和操作段；同日跨页合并。保留命令式及单独“x”，不补流程缺漏或声称每一步均已执行。

title: PCR test extracted DNA samples (optimize)
body:
This time, we used PCR protocol from paper:
PCR reaction mix prep:
● 12.5 ul of Phusion Plus Master Mix
● 1 ul of 20uM of each ThripsITSF (20 pmol)
● 1 ul of 20uM of each ThripsITSR (20 pmol)
● 1 ul of 20uM of each SdITSF3 (20 pmol)
● 1 ul of 20uM of each SdITSF7 (20 pmol)
● 5 ul of extracted DNA
● 3.5 of H2O


PCR conditions:

Initial denaturation 94°C 9 min
Denaturation 94°C 30 sec
}35 cycles
Annealing 52°C 30 sec
Extension 72°C 1 min
Final extension 72°C 7 min

Mix PCR samples with loading dye (5:1) and use the appropriate ladder (with bands on 200-500 bp). Run on gel 2% agarose gel (1 g of agarose dissolved in 50 ml of TAE) with 130 V for 15 min.
Clear bands near 200 bp (characteristic to C strain), one sample has band on 300 bp (characteristic to 300 bp).
Samples were loaded in this order: diluted ladder, miss, 7ng/ul extracted dna (trap water), 3.3 ng/ul, 2.6 ng/ul, 0.8 ng/ul, 0 ng/ul (Figure 1).
selection_note: 记录PCR配方、2%琼脂糖电泳及200/300bp条带结果；保留“3.5 of H2O”和“characteristic to 300 bp”等原文，作者及团队未确认。
